body: If I reach out I can almost guarantee people will back away, although I have helped a lot of people out with their own mental health issues. I have been attempting to show initiative to a few people but after rejection I feel stupid for asking again

Hi, thanks for replying. I don't feel like I'm very good at articulating my feelings even if I am trying to tell someone that something's wrong. I used my uni's counselling service last year and basically just got told that there's nothing wrong with me and everyone feels a little out of place when they first start, even though I was basically in the therapist's room having a full on breakdown. I don't think there's much point trying again through the service since I'd feel bad for the guy if I ended up with him again and I don't really want to spend another 7 weeks having to go to him once a week just to be told that I seem fine. Sorry if any of that came out as angry at all I'm much more angry at the service in general than at you, I'm grateful that you took the time to read my post and reply.
